CIVIL SERVANTS (SENIORITY) RULES, 1993
CIVIL SERVANTS (SENIORITY) RULES, 1993
(Amendment of R. 4-A)
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
11th April, 2018]
S.R.O.
437(I)/2018, dated 11.4.2018.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 25 of the Civil
Servants Act, 1973, (LXXI of 1973),
read with Notification No.S.R.O. 120(I)/1998, dated the 27th February, 1998,
the Prime Minister is pleased to direct that the following further amendments
shall be made in the Civil Servants (Seniority) Rules, 1993 namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 4A, after the word "merger", the words
"or devolution", shall be inserted.
